left_panel: Exact base projection x=t^2, z=-2t^3/3 for eta=1, -1/4<=t<=1/4. Increasing time goes from the positive-z incoming cap to the negative-z outgoing cap through strict tangency. The boundary tangential Hamilton field is zero.
right_panel: Exact cap-travel time 2(sqrt(1/16+beta)-sqrt(max(beta,0))), beta in [-1/64,1/64]. Continuous at beta=0, with a square-root corner on the reflected side.
